titles.title: A stochastic analysis of subcritical Euclidean fermionic field theories

rightsList.rights: arXiv.org perpetual, non-exclusive license to distribute; all other rights reserved to the authors

descriptions.description: Building on previous work on the stochastic analysis for Grassmann random variables, we introduce a forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE) which provides a stochastic quantisation of Grassmann measures. Our method is inspired by the so-called continuous renormalisation group, but avoids the technical difficulties encountered in the direct study of the flow equation for the effective potentials. As an application, we construct a family of weakly coupled subcritical Euclidean fermionic field theories and prove exponential decay of correlations.
